title: Funnel Analysis
content: Build funnel visualization for conversions. Steps: horizontal or vertical funnel stages. Metrics: show count and percentage at each step. Drop-off: highlight drop-off between steps. Comparison: compare funnels for different segments. Time period: select date range for analysis. Drill down: click step for detailed breakdown. Benchmarks: show industry or historical benchmarks.

variants.simple: Visualize conversion funnel with step metrics.
variants.detailed: Build funnel visualization for conversions. Steps: horizontal or vertical funnel stages. Metrics: show count and percentage at each step. Drop-off: highlight drop-off between steps. Comparison: compare funnels for different segments. Time period: select date range for analysis. Drill down: click step for detailed breakdown. Benchmarks: show industry or historical benchmarks.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive funnel analysis visualization. Funnel structure: horizontal bars narrowing left to right, or vertical stacked segments. Step data: step name, count at step, percentage of previous step, percentage of total (entry). Drop-off highlighting: show drop-off percentage between steps (red text or bar), visualize lost users at each transition. Funnel shape: proportional widths based on actual numbers, or fixed step heights with overlay fill. Step details: hover for tooltip with full metrics, click for drilldown to user list or sub-funnel. Time-based: select date range, see funnel for that period, compare to previous period. Segmentation: compare funnels side by side (mobile vs desktop, new vs returning), segment selector dropdown. Cohort funnels: track specific cohort through funnel over time. Step timing: average time between steps, time distribution histogram. Goal conversion rate: overall funnel conversion rate prominently displayed, trend vs previous period. Breakdowns: within each step, see breakdown by dimension (source, device, campaign). User paths: show alternate paths users take (not just linear). Exclusions: ability to exclude segments from funnel. Annotations: mark events that affected funnel (feature launch, bug). Benchmarks: optional benchmark line showing target or industry average. Export: funnel data as CSV, funnel image as PNG. Interactive: click and drag to reorder steps for ad-hoc analysis. A/B comparison: compare funnel between experiment variants. Alerts: notify when step conversion drops below threshold.
